summary: Frontend-only verification of compact home strips, nav/see-all routing changes, section reorder, mobile 390 overflow, and /cinema + /publicites regression. All 6 review items pass with 0 console errors.

arrows_behavior.note: At 1440 with 4 ad cards (sm:w=360px lg:w=400px), AdGrid tiles overflow slightly so commercials-section-arrows ARE visible at 1440; films arrows correctly hidden. This matches 'arrows hidden entirely when everything fits' spec (films fits, commercials does not at 1440 with 4 items).

verified.section_order_correct: films -> commercials -> dna(manifesto) -> vision -> expertise -> discover -> press -> contact : ORDERED=true
verified.no_scroll_jack: Vertical wheel over films-strip: window.scrollY 10115 -> 10615 (page scrolls, strip does not capture)

critical_code_review_comments: Strip.jsx: StripArrows correctly hides when (edges.start && edges.end); ResizeObserver re-evaluates on viewport change. Clean and native (no wheel capture) — vertical scrolling is preserved.
Films.jsx HomeStrip puts title + arrows + see-all on one row (sm:flex-row sm:items-end sm:justify-between). On 390 it stacks (flex-col), confirmed no overflow.

lib/nav.js useGoTo prefers t.nav[].route and calls navigate+scrollTo(0,0); otherwise navigates to '/' with state.scrollTo for cross-page scroll — matches 'cinema -> contact goes to home contact section' spec.
i18n.withNewPages() backfills missing route on saved nav items by looking up defaultContent.nav by id, so Cinema/Publicites menu entries route correctly even for legacy saved menus.
Home.jsx renders in exact spec order: Films, Commercials, Manifesto(dna), Vision, Expertise, Discover, Press, Contact — Press now above Contact, DNA/vision/expertise above Press.

AdGrid home strip card width (sm:w-[360px] lg:w-[400px] * 4 = ~1600px) exceeds max-w-[1500px] inner container at 1440, so commercials arrows legitimately appear at 1440. If the client's intent was 'arrows hidden at 1440 for 4 items' for commercials too, consider shrinking lg:w-[400px] to ~340px. For 1500+ widths they would hide. Minor UX nit, not a bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 review items pass. Testids used: films-section, commercials-section, films-strip, commercials-strip, films-section-arrows[-prev/-next], commercials-section-arrows[-prev/-next], films-see-all, commercials-see-all, nav-link-films/-commercials/-contact, mobile-nav-link-*, film-card-N, commercial-card-N. Section testids for order: manifesto-section (id='dna'), vision-section, expertise-section, discover-section, press-section, contact-section. Only observation: at 1440 commercials arrows are visible because 4 ad cards (lg:w-400px) exceed the 1500px max container; this is consistent with 'hide when everything fits' logic (it does not fit).
